landing.feature1Desc: Photographs, documents, testimonies and interviews, organized with clear source, date and verification.
landing.feature2Desc: Join communities by region, families, veterans, researchers and archivists.
landing.feature3Desc: Share memories and thoughts, discuss history openly — without hate speech or personal attacks.
landing.feature4Desc: An AI + human system that distinguishes civil criticism from abuse, for a safe and respectful space.
landing.standardsBody: We welcome open, critical historical discussion. We do not allow insults, threats, dehumanization or personal attacks against veterans, fallen fighters, families, historical figures or any other user. This standard applies equally to everyone.

rules.intro: UÇK Connect rigorously protects historical truth and honors national sacrifice. These rules apply equally to all users and are enforced automatically by our AI moderation engine, with human review when necessary.
rules.distinctionBody: The archive fully protects critical debate, analysis of historical events, and fact-based interpretations — words like “mistake”, “failure”, or “criticism” are never flagged. The system only intervenes when language contains insults, threats, or direct denigration of people, living or deceased.
rules.allowed1: Critical historical discussion, based on facts, archival documents, and credible testimony.
rules.allowed2: Analysis and criticism of historical decisions, operations, or interpretations — even when unfavorable.
rules.allowed3: Sharing personal or family memories, photographs, and documents, with a clear source when possible.
rules.allowed4: Unconditional respect for martyrs, veterans, families, and civilian victims of the war.
rules.forbidden1: Insults, abuse, or personal attacks against any user or historical figure.
rules.forbidden2: Threats, expressed violence, or incitement to it.
rules.forbidden3: Dehumanization or deliberate denigration of martyrs, veterans, or their families.
rules.forbidden4: Attempts to bypass moderation filters through symbols, artificial spacing, or deliberate letter substitution.
rules.forbidden5: Spam, scams, or repeated abusive content.
